name: University College Maastricht (Liberal Arts and Sciences)

credential.localTitle: Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science

summary: Three years in which you build your own curriculum from across the sciences, social sciences and humanities, choose a concentration as you go, and are taught in groups small enough that not preparing is visible. Two hundred and fifty places, an interview rather than a ranking, and a first year you must pass at 45 of 60 credits or leave. If the breadth of the Diploma is the part you liked, this is its continuation.
